title: 第1章 杀人第2章 屠村
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
第一章
杀人
修行，炼五谷之精，纳五谷之气，绝漏以延年，凝丹可炼气，化婴望长生。
在紫荆州西部，有一座齐云峰，高耸入云，是修仙者眼中的绝地。
山上电闪雷鸣，飞禽难入，山下气候极端，冬寒而夏烈，走兽难存，饶是如此，却有一古老山村在此，历经千年不散。
兴许是山村太过偏僻，又或者只有寥寥数十户，村子连个正式的名字都没有，村民常年以打猎为生，镇上索性就称他们为猎户村。
山下气候差，土地贫瘠不生庄稼，以猎换粮，成了村子唯一的生路，狩猎是每个壮年人的基本生存本领，也是全部本领，在这里，不用农耕，更不用读书识字。
如果说村里有人识字，那也只有村长了，狩猎，售猎，置换米粮，能识字，会算账，才能保证交易合理，不被镇上的奸商蒙蔽。
“星河，快回来识字！以后到镇上买卖的重任，就要交到你手上了”房檐下，身姿佝偻，白发垂落的老村长，望着院中一个正在舞枪弄棒的少年，厉声喝道。
少年叫苏星河，十二岁的年纪，是村长的孙子，父亲早年进山打猎，再也没有出来，母亲身患顽疾，再加上丧夫之痛，不久也离开人世，只留他与爷爷相依为命。
“来了！”苏星河小跑着进屋，他不喜欢读书，想跟着村里的大人进山打猎，这两年，同龄人都开始陆续进山打猎，只剩自己还没有进过山，许多同龄人，私下都喊自己是废柴，还是那种不带把儿的废柴。
想归想，苏星河却不能让爷爷失望，这些年，若非爷爷辛苦抚养，自己一个无父无母的孤儿，可能早就夭折了，如今爷爷希望自己能继承他的衣钵，即使不愿，也只能藏在心里了。
无精打采的翻开书本，眼睛却是看向了桌角，一个青翠的瓷瓶。
瓷瓶造型怪异，瓶底滚圆，瓶颈细长，两侧各有一个突兀耳柄，看起来有点像镇上酒馆里的酒壶，却没有壶嘴，顶端一个土黄色木塞，将唯一的瓶口堵上了。
最怪异的是木塞如何用力都拔不出来，若非材质不同，到像是一体的，苏星河用刀去撬，看似普通的木塞，没有留下丝毫痕迹，还发出了金石交击的摩擦声。
瓶子是昨日捡来的，在远山瀑布之下，读书厌倦了的苏星河，偷偷带着鱼叉，跑到了瀑布下，鱼没插到，却见银河般倾泻的瀑布中，掉落了这个瓷瓶，在水面上起起伏伏，甚至多次撞击石壁，都不曾碎裂。
“去找虎子试试，他力气大，兴许能够拔出木塞。”少年人的好奇心一旦被勾引，无论如何都要弄个明白，趁着爷爷不注意，苏星河偷偷溜了出去。
山地坎坷不平，适合建房的地方不多，所以家家户户相隔很远，到虎子家，甚至要翻越一个小峭壁，这对于苏星河来说，并不困难。
转过一处峭壁，忽听有人说话，两人一说一应，听清了说话的声音，苏星河心里咯噔一下，好巧不巧，正是有过节刘家兄弟。
苏星河废柴的称号，甚至更难听的不带把儿的娘们儿，就是从刘家兄弟二人嘴里传出，为此，双方闹过不少摩擦，甚至还为此动过手，只是之前都是有旁人在场，没有彻底撕破脸，眼下可是狭路相逢了。

前方就是路口，两人很快就要转过来，此时再想躲开已来不及，更何况，见面就跑，传出去，岂不是坐实了废柴称号。
“呦！这不是未来的村长继承人吗？这是要去哪啊！”转出峭壁的刘家兄弟二人，显然没料到会遇到苏星河，愣了一下后，二刘子这才反应过来，揶揄道。
苏星河没答话，错身就想穿过峭壁拐角，此时与二人起争执可不是明智之选。
“别着急走啊，看你这路线，是要去找虎子吧？平日仗着虎子给你出头，没机会教训你，今天我们哥俩儿就给你松松筋骨吧！”大刘子随着苏星河的脚步，栖身上前，挡住他的去路。
“你们......”
“打！”不等苏星河开口，二刘子招呼一声，率先抡拳进攻。
苏星河连忙后退，别说以一敌二，就单独面对一人，也没有胜算，刘家兄弟虽说比不得虎子虎背熊腰，比起常年窝在书桌旁读书的自己，强的可就不只一星半点，只看他粗壮的手臂，要是被抡中了，恐怕当场就得歇菜。
“你能躲到哪去！”眼看苏星河想躲，大刘子疾走两步抄了他的后路，抬脚便踢。
苏星河闪身躲开，斜刺里，二刘子一拳再次挥出，此时躲无可躲，只能伸手招架。
二刘子多次进山打猎，搏斗经验丰富，一拳被苏星河架住，手臂顺势回旋，一记凶狠的肘击直撞苏星河面门。
拳，脚，肘，只是瞬间变换，苏星河眼看最后这一肘到了面门，却再也来不及格挡，只听嗡的一声，却是头脑受到重击后的沉闷声响，眼前一黑，鼻腔一热，顿时仰面倒去。
“废柴，除了会写几个酸字，还有什么用，还不是靠我们打猎养活你们爷孙两个废物！”二刘子一击得手，没有继续追击，俯瞰苏星河。
“靠你们养活？若不是爷爷从中盘算，你们能卖出公平的价格？能换回足额的米粮？忘了你爹怎么被镇上李掌柜坑骗了？”苏星河爬起身，不管鼻腔鲜血直流，听到对方侮辱自己的爷爷，顿时火冒三丈。
自己可以被侮辱，但侮辱我爷爷绝对不行！这是苏星河的软肋。

Chapter 1
kill
Practice, refine the essence of the five grains, absorb the Qi of the five grains, and prevent leakage to prolong life. Condensing elixirs can refine the Qi, transform into babies and hope for immortality.
In the west of Bauhinia Prefecture, there is Qiyun Peak, towering into the clouds. It is a desperate place in the eyes of immortal cultivators.
There are lightning and thunder on the mountain, making it difficult for birds to enter. The climate below the mountain is extreme, with cold winters and hot summers, making it difficult for animals to survive. Despite this, there is an ancient mountain village here that has lasted for thousands of years.
Maybe the mountain village is too remote, or maybe there are only a few dozen households. The village doesn't even have a formal name. The villagers make a living by hunting all year round, so the town simply calls them Orion Village.
The climate below the mountain is poor, and the land is barren and cannot grow crops. Hunting for food has become the only way for the village to survive. Hunting is the basic survival skill of every mature person, and it is also the entire skill. Here, there is no need for farming, let alone reading and literacy.
If anyone in the village is literate, it is only the village chief who can hunt, sell hunting, exchange rice and grain, be literate, and know how to do accounts, so that he can ensure that transactions are reasonable and that he will not be deceived by profiteers in the town.
"Xinghe, come back quickly and learn how to read! From now on, the important task of doing business in the town will be handed over to you." Under the eaves, the old village chief, with a stooped posture and white hair hanging down, looked at a young man who was dancing with a gun and a stick in the courtyard, and shouted sharply.
The boy's name is Su Xinghe. He is twelve years old and is the grandson of the village chief. His father went into the mountains to hunt in his early years and never came out. His mother suffered from a chronic illness and the pain of losing her husband, and soon passed away, leaving him and his grandfather to depend on each other.
"Here we come!" Su Xinghe trotted into the house. He didn't like studying and wanted to go hunting in the mountains with the adults in the village. In the past two years, his peers had started to go hunting in the mountains one after another, but he was the only one who had never been in the mountains. Many of his peers privately called him a loser, the kind of loser who didn't have a handle.
Thinking about it, Su Xinghe couldn't let his grandfather down. If it hadn't been for his grandfather's hard work in raising him over the years, he might have died a long time ago as an orphan without a father and mother. Now his grandfather hopes that he can inherit his mantle, and even if he doesn't want to, he can only hide it in his heart.
He opened the book listlessly, but his eyes turned to the corner of the table, a green porcelain vase.
The porcelain bottle has a strange shape, with a rounded bottom, a slender neck, and an abrupt ear handle on each side. It looks a bit like a wine bottle in a tavern in the town, but it has no spout. An earthy-colored wooden stopper at the top blocks the only mouth of the bottle.
The weirdest thing was that the cork couldn't be pulled out no matter how hard it was. If it weren't for the different materials, it seemed to be one piece. Su Xinghe used a knife to pry it off. The seemingly ordinary cork left no trace at all, and even made a friction sound like gold and stone.
The bottle was picked up yesterday. Su Xinghe, who was tired of studying, secretly took the harpoon under the waterfall in the distant mountains. The fish did not get in, but he saw that the porcelain bottle fell into the waterfall pouring like a galaxy. It rose and fell on the water, and even hit the stone wall many times without breaking.
"Go and try Huzi. He is very strong and may be able to pull out the cork." Once the young man's curiosity was aroused, he had to find out no matter what. Su Xinghe sneaked out while his grandfather wasn't paying attention.
The mountains are rugged and there are not many places suitable for building houses, so every household is far apart. To get to Huzi's house, you even have to climb a small cliff, which is not difficult for Su Xinghe.
When they turned around a cliff, they suddenly heard someone talking. The two of them responded to each other, and when they heard the voices clearly, Su Xinghe's heart skipped a beat. What a coincidence, it was the Liu family brothers who were having a special occasion.
The title of Su Xinghe's loser, and even the even more unpleasant title of "untie bitch" came from the mouths of the two Liu brothers. For this reason, the two sides had a lot of friction and even fought over it. However, there were other people present before, so they didn't completely break up, but now they met on a narrow road.
There is an intersection ahead, and the two of them will turn around soon. It is too late to escape now, not to mention, running away after meeting and spreading the word, wouldn't it be true?Got the title of loser.
"Hey! Isn't this the future heir to the village chief? Where are we going!" The two Liu brothers who turned out of the cliff obviously did not expect to meet Su Xinghe. After being stunned for a moment, Liu Zi finally realized and teased.
Su Xinghe didn't answer, and wanted to cross the corner of the cliff. It was not a wise choice to argue with the two at this time.
"Don't leave in a hurry. Judging from your route, you are going to find Hu Zi, right? I usually rely on Hu Zi to help you, and I don't have the chance to teach you a lesson. Today, we two brothers will relax your muscles and bones!" Da Liuzi followed Su Xinghe's footsteps and stepped forward to block his way.
"You..."
"Hit!" Before Su Xinghe could say anything, Er Liuzi called out and took the lead in attacking with fists.
Su Xinghe quickly retreated, not to mention one against two, facing one person alone had no chance of winning. Although the Liu brothers were not as strong as a tiger, they were not only a little stronger than himself who had been sitting at the desk studying all year round. Just look at his thick arms. If he was hit, he would probably have to stop eating on the spot.
"Where can you hide!" Seeing Su Xinghe trying to hide, Da Liuzi took two quick steps and blocked his path, then raised his foot and kicked.
Su Xinghe dodged and stabbed diagonally. Er Liuzi punched out again. At this time, he had no choice but to stretch out his hand to parry.
Er Liuzi had gone hunting in the mountains many times and had rich fighting experience. He was blocked by Su Xinghe with one punch. His arm spun around and hit Su Xinghe's face with a fierce elbow.
Fists, kicks, and elbows all changed in an instant. Su Xinghe saw that the last elbow reached his face, but he had no time to block it. He only heard a buzzing sound, which was the dull sound of a heavy blow to the head. His vision went dark, his nose felt hot, and he immediately fell on his back.
"Good-for nothing, apart from being able to write a few bad words, what's your use? Why don't you rely on us to hunt to support you and your grandson, two losers!" Er Liuzi succeeded with one blow and did not continue the pursuit, overlooking Su Xinghe.
"Relying on you? If grandpa hadn't figured it out, how could you have sold it at a fair price? Can you get enough rice in exchange? Have you forgotten how your father was deceived by shopkeeper Li in the town?" Su Xinghe got up, regardless of the blood flowing from his nose. When he heard the other party insulting his grandpa, he suddenly became furious.
You can be insulted, but you can never insult my grandfather! This is Su Xinghe's weakness.
